notes:
Adds TYPE to the content type definitions.  This is consistent with RFC 5911's erratum 2612 which specifies how to define a content type: "ct-Foo CONTENT-TYPE ::= {TYPE Foo IDENTIFIED BY id-Foo}".

Alternatively, this ASN.1 module could change its CONTENT-TYPE import from CryptographicMessageSyntax-2009 to CryptographicMessageSyntax-2010, however that would interfere with other text in RFC 9939 including a normative reference.
